sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Sovereign Agentic Website: a website built by agents and owned by the person it is for.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: The name, the promise, sovereign, agentic, open and hosted, and AgentiCCells as the company.

sections.label: Why a new name
sections.line: The website cell undersold it; AgentiCCells sells agentic teams, so the website gets its own brand.
sections.para: To compete with WordPress and Wix.

sections.label: Why these two words
sections.line: Sovereign is the claim only we can make; agentic is what differs from the web of 2000.
sections.para: Owned and movable; built and changed by agents.

sections.label: An open pattern, and a hosted version
sections.line: An open pattern anyone can use without paying us, and a hosted version on sovereignwebsite.site.

sections.label: What we have, as of today
sections.line: The domains and the GitHub organisation are ours; the factory and the cell already make these sites.

sections.label: What happens to AgentiCCells
sections.line: AgentiCCells stays the company selling agentic teams; SAW is one of its cells.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Mock-ups are proposals; prices as published; sovereign means owning and moving.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The website cell, factory, sovereignty and registrar pieces, and 19 November's decisions.
